evidence_type: Assistant visual transcription of the learner-supplied DBeaver aggregate screenshot; all five rows and twelve field positions, including every complete PASS value, are visible. No direct learner-database read.
comparison_scope: All same-item/store adjacent transitions within the accepted twelve-week input window, 2016-01-30 through 2016-04-22, with current endpoints 2016-02-06 through 2016-04-22. The fixed row order is UP, DOWN, UNCHANGED, MISSING_ENDPOINT, TOTAL. Zero-sales transitions and missing price endpoints remain included.
display_normalization: Remove displayed thousands separators from transitions, distinct_pairs, previous_units, current_units and unit_difference, retaining signed JSON integers. Restore only omitted trailing zeros in mean_unit_change and median_unit_change to six-decimal strings, and sales_up_pct, sales_down_pct and sales_unchanged_pct to four-decimal strings. For example 3.19466 becomes 3.194660, 3.25 becomes 3.250000, median 1 becomes 1.000000, 21.395 becomes 21.3950 and 50 becomes 50.0000. Preserve group/status text and row/column order. NULL would remain JSON null; none is displayed.
fingerprint_method: SHA256 over the five ordered report row arrays, each in output_columns order, encoded as UTF-8 compact JSON with ensure_ascii=True, comma/colon separators and one LF after every row, including TOTAL. Counts and unit sums are JSON integers, means/medians fixed-six-place strings and percentages fixed-four-place strings. This is the frozen SQL46 report hash protocol, not a hash of the results object list.
scope: All 60 displayed aggregate values match the frozen preflight report after display normalization. Screenshot acceptance establishes agreement of the learner-visible report and its displayed arithmetic controls; it does not independently audit the learner database, reconstruct distinct pair sets or individual distributions, or test conceptual understanding. Complete weekly/source comparisons, independent medians/sign counts, SQL45 reconciliation, three focused cases, preservation of seven inputs/source/dependency hashes and 44 historical preflights, and private-file cleanup remain separate historical assistant preflight evidence. Mean changes are signed quantities in units per transition; percentages measure the frequency of sales direction and include zero-sales transitions, not growth rates or causal effects. Both UP and DOWN have positive mean changes in this unadjusted report; group composition, baseline sales and calendar exposure can differ. UNCHANGED is a descriptive reference, not a causal control. Adjacent transitions overlap and repeated pairs are not independent experiments. MISSING_ENDPOINT has zero previous units but 52 current units, so missing-price coverage does not imply both endpoints have zero sales. This accepts an initial descriptive association only, with no elasticity, promotion lift, profit, stockout, anomaly or statistical-significance claim. Prior forecasting choices and historical evidence remain unchanged.
